instruction: A candid outdoor photograph captured in a wide, eye-level shot. On a grassy riverbank next to a calm body of water, two people perform matching yoga poses. On the left, the man in the green t-shirt (R2) balances on his right leg, extending his left leg straight back while leaning his torso forward. On the right, the woman in the green sports bra (R1) mirrors him, balancing on her left leg with her right leg extended back. Both individuals stretch their arms straight out in front of them, reaching toward each other without making physical contact. Their gazes are focused forward. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural daylight, casting gentle shadows on the green grass, with a background of lush trees and water.
